english_outline.section_1_main_conclusion: Lam Research reported record fiscal Q1 2026 revenue and profit, beating consensus on both lines, yet the stock fell after hours. Reuters/Investing.com attributes the drop to a sell-the-news reaction after a large prior run-up.
english_outline.section_2_core_business_changes: Systems revenue jumped sequentially to $5.73 billion from $4.25 billion, driven by AI demand and rising chip complexity. China was the largest geographic contributor at 35% of sales, followed by Korea at 20% and Taiwan at 18%.
english_outline.section_3_expectations_impact: Non-GAAP gross margin expanded 40 basis points sequentially to 52.4%, and non-GAAP operating margin reached 40.2%. Operating cash flow was $3.50 billion, supporting over $1.3 billion returned to shareholders. Guidance for the December quarter topped consensus but carried a wide range.
english_outline.section_4_market_pricing: Shares slipped about 6% in after-hours trading. Investing.com characterized the move as a classic sell-the-news dynamic. No named institutional rating or target price changes were provided in the source material.
english_outline.section_5_next_quarter_validation: The key validation point is whether December-quarter revenue lands within the $8.2 billion to $9.0 billion guidance range and whether non-GAAP EPS falls within $2.18 to $2.48, confirming that AI-driven demand and margin expansion are sustainable.

reader_questions: 公司官方财报确认的营收、营业利润、净利润和经营现金流分别是多少？这些数字与市场报道中的非 GAAP 口径是否一致？
系统收入从上一季度的 42.5 亿美元跃升至 57.3 亿美元，这一变化是否在官方来源中得到确认？它如何改变对增长和利润率的预期？
市场报道称股价盘后下跌约 6%，并归因于‘利好出尽’。在给定来源中，是否有具名机构发布评级调整或目标价变动来支持这一归因？
checks: 官方 SEC 文件确认：营收 8,219,418,000 美元、营业利润 3,283,727,000 美元、净利润 2,753,138,000 美元、经营现金流 3,497,652,000 美元。市场报道中的非 GAAP 每股收益 2.20 美元和营收 82.2 亿美元与官方 GAAP 营收一致，但非 GAAP 指标本身不在官方来源中，需明确区分口径。
系统收入从 42.5 亿美元增至 57.3 亿美元仅见于 Investing.com 报道，官方来源未提供该分项数据。该变化支持‘先进沉积与刻蚀设备需求走强’的业务判断，并对应非 GAAP 毛利率环比提升 40 个基点至 52.4%、营业利润率 40.2% 的利润率扩张预期。
给定来源中没有具名研究机构发布评级调整或目标价变动。Investing.com 将盘后下跌约 6% 归因于‘利好出尽’、过去一年累计上涨近 80% 后的获利了结，以及芯片设备板块财报季前的谨慎情绪。因此，不能将市场反应表述为机构分歧的结果。
